src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: Compile a Lumen DSL block and update the scene only from core output.
note: 69 characters: the main construction tool has almost no description; the grammar is pinned in the system prompt instead.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: generate_image — generate a raster image from prompt and register it (NOT auto-placed). Pass target_node_id so the aspect is derived from that frame's geometry — images are cropped to fill, never stretched.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: reference_asset_ids selects up to four inspected style inputs … Omit it to use turn attachments; [] uses no references. A selection replaces automatic attachments … reference_roles: source, treatment, composition. reference_framing states what to preserve/vary.
note: Omitting reference_asset_ids on an auto-reference turn feeds the brand's own published ads as style inputs; the revamp picked its own references instead.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: Viewing an asset alone does not attach it. Keep exact UI and logos as separate source layers; this action produces a new raster component.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: edit_image — edit the image already placed in node_id (recolor / warmth / background / fix a flawed subject) WITHOUT changing the composition … Prefer this over a full regenerate when the image is right-but-flawed.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: crop_image — extract an exact rectangle from an inspected original raster, without a model or resampling … Inspect, then explicitly place it. Cannot recover occluded or absent UI.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: generate_qr — deterministic QR asset; for physical artifacts set print_media=True and target_width_mm.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: place — place an existing asset (generated this run, or from the workspace library) into an existing image or reserved empty leaf, or a bound image slot … fit (default cover), focal point, alt, preserve_transparency. Reversible.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: use_brand_asset — register one of the attached Brand Kit's assets … Logos place with fit contain (never cropped); pick the variant by background (reversed on dark fields). Requires an attached kit.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: Use this whenever the design shows a company that is not us … Returns one asset per FAMILY CELL (light/dark × lockup/mark) … A cell is missing when the brand publishes nothing for it … never filled by recoloring another cell.
note: Duplicates A2's logo block; the SCENE_LOGO_SELECTION_GUIDANCE paragraph is pasted into both.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: Use a cell first; reach for an alternative only when the cell does not fit the placement … and say so. Pass force_refresh=True only when the user says the logo is wrong or outdated.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: If it comes back needs_review … Say so and ask for the file. Never draw, recolor or approximate a logo.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: The scene must already contain a page/artboard: on a pageless scene this tool REFUSES before fetching (scene.page_required) — author the page first.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: Validate a Phase G binding set (per-recipient values, links, QR entries) against the current scene's slot contracts … Returns precise LUMG diagnostics.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: Apply a typed targeted edit through the Rust edit builder … must be a JSON object matching the helper contract, e.g. {"kind":"modify","target":{"kind":"node","id":"headline"},"patch":{…}}.

src: tool descriptions: compile_dsl_block, asset, fetch_logo, validate_binding_set, apply_structured_edit
text: Repairs for a concrete critic issue must declare their scope so the engine can reject out-of-scope mutations: "scope": {"mode": "strict", "allowed": [...]}.
